ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 354 Section ADF is the Honors section for MCB Honors students and James Scholars. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu for information and approval. This class will meet in C120 CLSL. Both lecture and discussions begin on Monday, August 25, 2014. Discussion sections will not meet the week of September 1, 2014. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 23, October 14, and November 11, 2014.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
